title: Lakefront|FREE heated POOL|SPA|Paddleboat|Ocotillo

 NO extra fees for heating . The heat is set to run from 9am-9pm and set to 85-90 F. Pool heat is relative to outdoor temperature. When the temperature goes below 60 outdoor, the pool temperature might not reach desired temperature.
